findings.description: Enumerated the ECE discipline-filtered OSU College of Engineering directory: page 0 (39 cards, pager next link to page=1) and page 1 (3 cards, no next link). 42 cards total, matching the 42 brief people by name. No omissions and no people on the brief missing from the pages.
Owner determinations of 2026-11-25 (Abd Arkadan, Tim Kane, Mehdi Abolhassani, Rohan Reddy Kalavakonda, Missouri S&T four) do not apply to this roster; none of those people are in the brief.

Profile pages were fetched only for three borderline people (Chan-Ho Kim, Eduardo Cotilla-Sanchez, Ben Lee). They repeat the directory card fields and add no further rank information. Other profiles were not fetched.

Eduardo Cotilla-Sanchez: included as regular/ece/current. Borderline: the professorial rank 'Professor' appears only in the Additional Positions field of the card and profile; the leading title is administrative. Would change to excluded (academic_professional) only if the college states the professorship is not an active ECE appointment. Profile https://engineering.oregonstate.edu/about/directory/eduardo-cotilla-sanchez cited.
Xiao Fu: courtesy included. Card title 'Courtesy Faculty' on the ECE roster is an explicit courtesy designation under policy category courtesy; membership ece; current.

Chan-Ho Kim: excluded as research_only. Title 'Assistant Professor (Senior Research)' on the ECE roster and profile is a research-track title. Would change to regular or joint_secondary only if an official source states a regular or joint EE/ECE teaching-track or professorial appointment.

Ben Lee: included as regular/ece/current. Borderline: the professorial rank 'Professor' appears only in the Additional Positions field of the card and profile; the leading title is administrative. Would change to excluded (academic_professional) only if the college states the professorship is not an active ECE appointment. Profile https://engineering.oregonstate.edu/about/directory/ben-lee cited.
Kartikeya Mayaram: excluded as emeritus (title 'Professor Emeritus').
Thomas Plant: excluded as emeritus (title 'Emeritus Appointment').
Rick Presley: excluded as research_staff (title 'Faculty Research Assistant').
Sisavath (Sisi) Virasak: excluded as academic_professional (title 'ORTSOC Senior Security Engineer').
John Wager: excluded as emeritus (title 'Professor Emeritus').

Regular professorial titles (Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, including Additional Positions for administrative roles) are included as regular/ece/current on the ECE roster per the department-roster convention. No source states a start date, so effective_from_json is null for all.
